title: Prompting
description: Write structural, specific prompts that direct an AI precisely: naming sections, layout, and placement instead of vague wishes.

checkpoints.title: Prompt basics
checkpoints.description: What a prompt is and how to describe a page's structure in one.

panels.caption: An AI builds what you describe. Vague wishes get vague pages. Structure gets structure.
A structural prompt names the parts of the page and where they go: 'A header with the site name, a main section with three cards, a footer with contact info.'
Structure first. Colors and fonts come after the layout is right.

starterFiles.index.html:
Nimbus

Weather for people who plan ahead. Layout coming soon!

steps.title: Direct the layout
steps.instructions:
Nimbus is a weather app startup. Its page is almost empty.

Write **one** prompt that describes the page's layout: which sections it has and where each one sits. Structure only, no colors or fonts yet.

Run your prompt and look at the result. Does the page have the sections you asked for?

validation.successCriteria: The generated page contains at least three visually distinct sections, such as a header, a main content area, and a footer.

checkpoints.title: Precise prompts
checkpoints.description: Rewrite vague wishes as precise instructions that name an element and the change wanted.

steps.title: Make it precise
steps.instructions:
Keep working on the Nimbus page.

Pick something vague you want to change ('make it nicer') and rewrite it as a precise instruction: name the element and say exactly what should change about it.

Useful words: header, hero, section, card, column, grid, navigation, footer, spacing, alignment.

Run the precise prompt and check that the page changed the way you asked.

validation.successCriteria: The student issued at least one specific, structural prompt naming an element and the change wanted, and the page reflects the change.
